name: wolfet-wasm
description: Play Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory in a web browser. Runs a WebAssembly/WebGL 2 client and a shared ET: Legacy Objective server with official maps, optional Omni-Bot population, custom PK3 support, and automatic idle sleep.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent official game data, generated configuration, bans, and custom_maps PK3 drop folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Browser game, WebSocket proxy, health, and status HTTP port.

ports.name: Enemy Territory UDP
ports.description: Native Enemy Territory dedicated-server query and connection port. Browser gameplay uses the Web UI port.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: arcade enables faster movement, double jump, unlimited stamina, hit sounds, and the optional visibility/targeting layer. vanilla uses stock-style movement and disables those additions.

variables.name: Match Population
variables.description: Human-plus-bot population maintained by the server; enter an integer from 2 through 63.

variables.name: Keep Server Alive
variables.description: Set true to keep the dedicated match running indefinitely. When false, only the lightweight web host remains active while idle.

variables.name: Idle Timeout
variables.description: When Keep Server Alive is false, stop the dedicated process after this long without human players. Accepts seconds or values such as 10m or 2h.

variables.name: Omni-Bot
variables.description: Set to 1 for automatic bot fill or 0 to disable bots.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Optional dedicated-server RCON password. Leave empty to generate and persist a random password under /data.

variables.name: Trusted Reverse Proxy
variables.description: Set to 1 only when a same-host reverse proxy replaces X-Forwarded-For and clients cannot bypass it.

variables.name: Administrator IPs
variables.description: Optional comma-separated admin IP allowlist for NAT or proxy setups where automatic same-host detection is insufficient.
